approved_sources.title: Ayurvedic Home Remedies
approved_sources.organization_author: Central Council for Research in Ayurveda and Siddha (CCRAS), Department of ISM&H, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt of India
approved_sources.intended_use: Practical home remedy knowledge and household dietary recipes for mild/chronic complaints
approved_sources.limitations: Home remedy recipes intended for mild conditions; advises consulting a doctor if no relief within 2-3 days; non-prescriptive
approved_sources.provenance_policy: Direct extraction linked to page number, plant name, and specific indication block

approved_sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part - II (Formulations), Volume - II
approved_sources.organization_author: Government of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of AYUSH
approved_sources.intended_use: Official statutory standards, formulation compositions, manufacturing processes, and classical therapeutic uses
approved_sources.limitations: Pharmacopoeial monographs; doses represent average adult guidance from AFI and are non-binding on prescribers; not patient-specific prescriptions
approved_sources.provenance_policy: Direct extraction linked to monograph name, category, page number, formula composition, and AFI reference

approved_sources.title: Indian Traditional Ayurvedic System of Medicine and Nutritional Supplementation
approved_sources.organization_author: M. M. Pandey, Subha Rastogi, and A. K. S. Rawat (CSIR-NBRI, Lucknow, India); Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (eCAM)
approved_sources.intended_use: Secondary review of ethnopharmacological claims, plant nutraceutical properties, and traditional formulation literature
approved_sources.limitations: Secondary background review; cannot independently trigger patient-specific clinical recommendations
approved_sources.provenance_policy: Direct extraction linked to article table/section and page number; marked strictly as secondary evidence

excluded_sources.reason: Fourth Ayurveda source is unreviewed and intentionally excluded from Phase 8B

governance_rules.zero_invention: No remedy, indication, ingredient, or citation may be created outside the approved documents
governance_rules.safety_lock: Emergency red-flag or critical clinical risk automatically blocks recommendation
governance_rules.dosage_policy: Source dosage notes are stored purely as reference excerpts and never formatted as prescriptions
